title: Les Roches
content: Abu Dhabi Hospitality Academy – Les Roches (ADHA–LR), established in September 2024, is redefining hospitality education in the UAE by combining global expertise with Emirati hospitality values. The Academy offers a Bachelor’s in Global Hospitality Management and a Master of Science in International Hospitality Management, with a Master’s in Sports Management and Events launching in 2026. Part of the Les Roches global network and Sommet Education, Les Roches is ranked World’s #2 for hospitality and leisure management by QS World University Rankings by Subject 2026. Learn more at www.lesroches.ae.

title: Aldar Hospitality
content: Aldar Hospitality, a subsidiary of Aldar Properties PJSC is one of the UAE’s leading hospitality and leisure operators, bringing together a portfolio of distinctive hotels, resorts, beaches, marinas and golf clubs. In partnership with renowned global hospitality brands, it transforms destinations through bespoke guest experiences, thoughtful service and memorable stays spanning beachfront havens, desert escapes, urban retreats and family resorts.

title: teamlab phenomena
content:
teamLab Phenomena Abu Dhabi showcases groundbreaking artworks by the international art collective teamLab. The installations are inspired by the balance between nature, the manufactured world, and the environment.

These living, evolving creations are shaped not only by natural forces but also by your interaction and engagement. Immerse yourself in these artworks and become one with the environment.

Situated in Saadiyat Cultural District, Abu Dhabi. It offers you a mind-blowing expedition that is different for each visitor and changes every time you visit.

title: Tourism365
content: Tourism365, the tourism arm of ADNEC Group, leads Abu Dhabi’s tourism industry by creating unforgettable travel experiences. With a vision to be a top travel organization in the MENA region, we connect travelers with unique destinations. Operating as a Destination Management Company (DMC) in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, and Jordan, we also offer corporate travel solutions through our Travel Management Company (TMC). Our tour operator brands, Capital Holidays and Etihad Holidays, serve clients in the UAE, UK, and Germany, catering to a wide range of travel needs, from budget to luxury.

title: Al Ain Museum
content:
Discover the story of Al Ain through thousands of years

Al Ain Museum explores the rich history and heritage of Al Ain and the region through archaeology and living traditions. Its collections trace human life from prehistoric times to the recent past, revealing how communities adapted and flourished across generations.

title: Abu Dhabi Pass
content:
The Abu Dhabi Pass is the City’s Official Sightseeing Pass, offering travelers seamless access to top attractions and exclusive savings across the capital.
The Platform also serves as the B2B ticket distribution platform for travel trade partners and DMCs, offering seamless wholesale access to 70+ top attractions and experiences, with exclusive freebies like eSIM, FnB discounts, Shopping Offers &more — all through a single self-service portal via a single contract. Partners enjoy exclusive rates, zero bulk sales commitments and no Forex Fees.

title: ADREA
content: Abu Dhabi Royal Equestrian Arts (ADREA) is the world’s fifth school of classical horsemanship and the first beyond Europe. Rooted in the Arab tradition of Furusiyya, ADREA brings together Emirati heritage, discipline and artistry through equestrian performance, education and immersive experiences. With accredited programmes, the Furusiyya Gallery, Junior Academy, saddle-making atelier and world-class facilities, ADREA preserves equestrian knowledge for future generations, guided by the highest standards of horse welfare and care.

title: Arabian Oryx Travel & Tourism LLC
content:
Arabian Oryx Travel & Tourism LLC is a leading Destination Management Company (DMC), established in the UAE in 2004. Backed by an experienced team, we deliver reliable travel solutions for corporate & leisure clients.

Our services include hotels, holidays, activities, staycations and MICE, tailored to our partners’ needs.

Our global B2B booking portal, B2B.AORYX.AE, offers travel agencies and corporate partners access to a vast selection of hotels worldwide, competitive rates & a seamless booking experience - anytime, anywhere.

YOUR MOST TRUSTED, EXPERIENCED & RELIABLE DMC PARTNER IN THE UAE

title: Gromaxx Hotels Management
content: Gromaxx Hotels Management LLC is a UAE-based hospitality management company overseeing a diverse portfolio of Wyndham-branded hotels across Abu Dhabi and Dubai. With a commitment to operational excellence, strategic growth and guest-centric experiences, Gromaxx delivers quality accommodation, dining, wellness and business solutions for leisure and corporate travellers. Through a dynamic portfolio spanning city hotels, extended-stay properties and boutique suites, Gromaxx continues to strengthen its presence in the UAE hospitality landscape while creating lasting value for guests, partners and stakeholders.

title: City Seasons Group of Hotels
content:
City Seasons Group offers distinctive stays across the Middle East, delivering warm hospitality and exceptional guest experiences.
Royal Rose Hotel Abu Dhabi, Curio Collection by Hilton: Elegant accommodations and fine dining.
City Seasons Al Hamra: Comfort in the heart of the city.
DoubleTree by Hilton Dubai Port Saeed: Convenient city location.
City Seasons Suites: Home-like suites with amenities.
City Seasons Towers: Comfort for business and leisure travelers in a central location.
City Seasons Muscat: Welcoming hospitality in a serene setting.

Always Great Moments!

title: Cristal Group
content: Cristal Group was initially established in the United Arab Emirates in 2007 under the private office of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan Bin Zayed Al Nahyan, with the aim of delivering world-class hospitality consultancy, technical services, asset management, and brand management. Cristal Group was later established in the British Virgin Islands in 2013. The company is currently managing assets worth over one billion UAE Dirhams, with an annual turnover of over one hundred million Dirhams.

title: Jannah Hotels & Resorts
content:
About Jannah Hotels & Resorts Jannah Hotels & Resorts is a UAE-based hospitality management company operating premium hotels, executive apartments, and lifestyle accommodations across the Emirates. Blending contemporary design, refined comfort, and authentic Arabian hospitality, the company creates memorable experiences tailored to the needs of today's travelers.

With a growing presence in Abu Dhabi, Dubai, and Ras Al Khaimah, Jannah continues to strengthen its footprint across the UAE. Driven by a commitment to service excellence, operational efficiency, and sustainable growth, the company delivers long-term value for guests, business partners, investors, and the communities it serves.

title: Four Seasons Abu Dhabi
content: Set on Al Maryah Island, Four Seasons Hotel Abu Dhabi offers an elevated waterfront retreat in the heart of the capital. Home to a Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star Hotel and Spa, the property is known for exceptional dining, world-class wellness, and warm, intuitive service. Steps from Abu Dhabi's financial hub and The Galleria, the city's premier shopping, dining, and entertainment destination, it provides seamless access to the Louvre Abu Dhabi, Yas Island, and the capital's leading cultural, business, and leisure attractions.

title: Emirates Tours and Safari
content:
Emirates Tours & Safari is an established inbound DMC in Abu Dhabi, specialising in desert experiences, corporate events, gala dinners, incentive travel, and customised UAE tours since 2011.

Our own desert venues, modern fleet of vehicles, and experienced operations team enable us to deliver well-organised and memorable experiences across Abu Dhabi, Dubai, and Al Ain.

Recognised with the World Travel Awards 2025 and 12 consecutive TripAdvisor Travellers’ Choice Awards, we are a trusted partner for travel agents and tour operators, providing reliable destination management services across the UAE.

title: Abu Dhabi National Hotels
content: Abu Dhabi National Hotels (ADNH) is a leading hospitality group managing a portfolio of premier properties: Sheraton Abu Dhabi Hotel & Resort, Le Méridien Abu Dhabi Resort, Radisson Blu Hotel & Resort, Abu Dhabi Corniche, and Radisson Blu Hotel & Resort, Al Ain. Combining world-class service with local culture, our hotels offer exceptional stays, dining, events, and world-class recreational facilities. ADNH is committed to excellence, innovation, and sustainability, creating memorable experiences that reflect the vibrant spirit of Abu Dhabi and the UAE.

title: Abu Dhabi Ports
content: The Abu Dhabi Ports Cruise Business team develops and operates an expanding network of cruise terminals, ferry terminals and marinas across the region. Working with cruise lines, tourism authorities and industry partners, we create connected passenger journeys, strengthen destination appeal and support sustainable tourism growth. From terminal operations to waterfront destinations, we help shape memorable visitor experiences while enabling regional connectivity and long-term value for our partners.

title: Air Arabia
content: Air Arabia is the Middle East and North Africa’s first and largest budget carrier operator. Air Arabia commenced operations in October 2003 and currently operates a fleet comprised of Airbus A320 & A321 aircraft, serving some 200 routes from six hubs in the UAE (Sharjah, Abu Dhabi, Ras Al Khaimah), Morocco, Egypt, and Pakistan (Fly Jinnah). Air Arabia Group is an award-winning airline operator that focuses on offering comfort, reliability, and value-for-money air travel. For further information, please visit: www.airarabia.com

title: Al Ain Adventure
content: Al Ain Adventure is the UAE’s premier land, water and sky adventure destination, set against the iconic Jebel Hafeet mountain. As the Adventure & Active Lifestyle Gateway to Al Ain, it brings together world-class experiences across water, land and sky, from whitewater rafting, kayaking and surfing to thrilling outdoor adventures. Designed for adventure seekers, families, schools, athletes and corporate groups, Al Ain Adventure offers something for everyone.

title: Al Raha Beach Resort & Spa
content: Al Raha Beach Resort & Spa is a distinguished 5-star beachfront resort in Abu Dhabi, offering 278 elegant rooms, suites, and private villas along a 900-meter private beach. Conveniently located 15 minutes from Abu Dhabi International Airport and 45 minutes from Dubai, the resort features eight dining venues, a luxury spa and wellness center, recreational facilities, and versatile meeting and event spaces. Combining exceptional service with contemporary comfort, it provides an ideal destination for leisure, business, and memorable seaside experiences.

title: Aloft Al Ain
content:
We're different. by design.

Coming or going, you’re welcome to express yourself in our comfortable and connected spaces. Make moves at Aloft Hotels as you plan the day ahead. Perfectly set in the heart of the city, Aloft Al Ain is a stylish addition to the Al Ain Square.

Our 4-star hotel boasts close proximity to Hazza Bin Zayed Stadium and Al Ain National Museum. Be part of the buzz as soon as you set foot in Aloft Hotels. Forward-thinking, modern design awaits you. Step into a space that immediately feels upbeat and exciting.

title: Aloft Hotel Abu Dhabi
content: Aloft by Marriott Abu Dhabi is a modern hotel located at the Abu Dhabi National Exhibition Centre (ADNEC), offering the perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience. Designed for today's travelers, the hotel provides comfortable accommodations, vibrant social spaces, and seamless connectivity. Whether visiting for business or leisure, guests enjoy easy access to major exhibitions, corporate hubs, and key city attractions. With flexible event venues and the signature Aloft vibes, the hotel delivers a fresh, engaging, and memorable stay experience.

title: Anantara Qasr Al Sarab Desert Resort
content: Relax, unwind and embrace the enigmatic allure of the Empty Quarter at the newly rejuvenated, award-winning Qasr Al Sarab Desert Resort by Anantara. The resort is proud to present discerning guests with an array of sumptuous accommodation, delicious flavours, thrilling desert activities as well as a signature blend of indulgences, Arabian hospitality and contemporary charm. Framed by desert vistas, our 207 rooms, suites and villas are sanctuaries appointed with modern conveniences, plush Middle Eastern fabrics, bronze chandeliers, oversized tubs and rain showers.

title: Andaz Capital Gate by Hyatt
content: Andaz Capital Gate Abu Dhabi is set within the iconic Capital Gate, the world's farthest-leaning tower, adjacent to ADNEC and just 15 minutes from Zayed International Airport. The hotel features 188 contemporary rooms and suites with panoramic city and Gulf views, locally inspired design, versatile event spaces, and distinctive dining experiences. Blending modern luxury with authentic Emirati character, Andaz offers an inspiring stay for business and leisure travelers in the heart of the UAE capital.

title: Arabian Ventures Tourism
content: At Arabian Ventures Tourism (AV Tourism), we create seamless travel experiences across the UAE and worldwide. From handpicked hotels and customized packages to visas, transfers, tours and attractions, we make every journey effortless. Our B2B booking portal gives travel partners easy access to competitive rates and global hotel inventory. With local expertise and global reach, AV Tourism is your trusted worldwide travel partner.

title: Ayla Grand Hotel - Al Ain
content: Ayla Hotels & Resorts Management Company was established in 2010 in Al Ain, UAE, and is owned by Nael Bin Harmal Investment Company, also owner of Bawadi Mall. Operating under a no-liquor concept, Ayla offers a safe, family-friendly environment respecting local traditions. The first Ayla Hotel opened in 2011, followed by Ayla Bawadi Hotel in 2014 and the five-star Ayla Grand Hotel in 2017. International expansion began with Ayla Ibri Hotel, Oman, in 2022, followed by Djibouti Ayla Grand Hotel in 2024, marking Ayla’s first presence on the African continent.

title: Bab Al Nojoum Hotels
content: From the tropical island spirit of Hudayriyat to the quiet dunes of Liwa and the mangrove forests of Mugheirah, Bab Al Nojoum brings the feeling of escape into everyday life. Each destination offers its own world of nature, adventure, and calm. Together, they form a collection of close-to-home escapes where the outdoors feels limitless and life unfolds in nature's rhythm. Unleash your inner explorer, spark your curiosity, and enter a whole new world at Bab Al Nojoum, your doorway to discovery.

title:
Bab Al Qasr 
Hotel & Residences
content: BAB AL QASR, meaning “door of the palace,” reflects its heritage through a striking Arabic doorway and gleaming copper-toned architecture. Inspired by Arabian culture, the hotel features Bedouin-style accents, Islamic geometric patterns, and a palm-filled lobby with a falaj-inspired water feature. This five-star hotel is located on the west end of Abu Dhabi and opened in late 2016. It is 38 km from Abu Dhabi International Airport and 90 minutes from Dubai. Bab Al Qasr offers 412 hotel rooms and suites and 265 serviced residences with luxurious modern design and stunning views of the Presidential Palace, Corniche, and Arabian Gulf.

title: Beach Rotana, Abu Dhabi
content: Beach Rotana Abu Dhabi is a renowned five-star waterfront resort, ideally located between downtown Abu Dhabi and Al Maryah Island. The award-winning hotel features 413 elegant rooms and suites, 12 restaurants and bars, an infinity pool, private beach, full gym, spa, tennis and squash courts, with direct access to Abu Dhabi Mall. Recognised by the World Travel Awards as the region’s leading corporate resort, Beach Rotana offers warm hospitality and exceptional experiences for both business and leisure travellers.

title: Conrad Abu Dhabi Eithad Towers
content: Conrad Abu Dhabi Etihad Towers is a luxury urban resort and culinary destination, home to over 12 world-class dining venues, a luxurious spa with 13 treatment rooms, a private beach, three swimming pools, and the Observation Deck at 300, offering breathtaking 360-degree views of the city from the 74th floor. Stay inspired in its 576 elegant rooms, suites, and residences, all with spectacular views of the Arabian Gulf. The resort is just minutes from the Presidential Palace, setting the standard for luxury hospitality and extraordinary experiences.

title: Cozmo Travel
content: Cozmo Travel is a full-service travel management company operating across 10 countries and a wholly owned subsidiary of Air Arabia Group, holding Official GSA status for the airline. Our services cover corporate travel management, holidays, B2B trade travel, ground mobility and limousine hire, freight forwarding and airline representation. A multilingual team and a 24/7 call centre support clients at every stage of the journey.

title: Desert Rose Tourism LLC
content: Desert Rose Tourism LLC is a leading Destination Management Company (DMC) based in Abu Dhabi, UAE, offering comprehensive tourism services across the UAE. We specialize in sightseeing, desert safaris, cultural experiences, corporate events, and luxury weddings. With dedicated teams in Abu Dhabi, Dubai, and the UK, we ensure exceptional guest service. Our exclusive Desert Rose Village offers premium overnight stays and an intimate setting for weddings, birthdays, and private celebrations.

title: Dusit Thani Abu Dhabi
content: Dusit Thani Abu Dhabi is a five-star luxury hotel blending gracious Thai hospitality with contemporary elegance in the heart of the UAE capital. The hotel features 533 rooms, suites and apartments, signature dining experiences, wellness and leisure facilities, and versatile meeting and event spaces. Ideally located near key business and government districts, it offers exceptional comfort and service for business and leisure travellers, families, events and memorable celebrations.

title: Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental Abu Dhabi
content:
Located on a pristine private beach, Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental, Abu Dhabi is the epitome of luxury in Abu Dhabi, showcasing Arabian hospitality at its finest. Each of the resort's rooms and suites is furnished to the highest levels of comfort, has stunning views and offers 24-hour butler service. Twelve dining venues serve a variety of cuisines created by world renowned chefs and the resort boasts lush gardens, a lavish spa, two temperature-controlled swimming pools, a kids' club and a private marina.

Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental is the pinnacle of luxury, reflecting the true warmth and generosity of Arabian hospitality with an Oriental flair.

Your Palace, Your Story.

title: Emirates Park Zoo & Resort
content: Emirates Park Zoo and Resort is a leading destination in Abu Dhabi that brings together conservation, education, animal welfare, and memorable experiences for visitors of all ages. With diverse species, educational programs, research, sustainability initiatives, and responsible animal interactions, the zoo works to strengthen the connection between people and nature. Its offering combines entertainment, learning, and hospitality, establishing it as an institution committed to conservation and sustainable development, while supporting families, schools, communities across the UAE.

title: ES Sport
content: ES Sport connects people through the power of sport. Since 2009, we've delivered premium sports experiences, sponsorship opportunities, and bespoke tours for brands, schools, teams, and fans across the Middle East and beyond. As Official Agents for the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, Emirates Dubai 7s, and Dubai Marathon, and former Official Agents for FIFA and ICC events, we provide unrivalled access to world-class sporting experiences while championing active lifestyles through flagship events and strategic partnerships.

title: Ethara
content: Ethara is shaping the future of entertainment, sport, culture, event services, and asset management regionally and internationally. Headquartered on Abu Dhabi’s Yas Island, and with offices in Dubai and Riyadh, the company employs over 300 professionals who offer an unrivalled wealth of expertise, experience, knowledge and skills. Ethara, meaning ‘thrill’ in Arabic, operates an impressive portfolio of assets, including Yas Marina Circuit, Etihad Park, Etihad Arena and the Yas Conference Centre. The company works with leading events companies, IP owners, and entertainment partners locally and internationally to deliver world-class, first-to-market events and experiences. For further information, visit: www.ethara.com

title: Fairmont Bab Al Bahr
content: Fairmont Bab Al Bahr is a landmark destination in Abu Dhabi, known for its exceptional waterfront setting, contemporary design, and iconic views of the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque. The hotel features elegantly appointed rooms and suites, distinctive dining venues, and world-class leisure facilities, including a private beach, Olympic-sized pool, and exclusive health club. Combining local character with global sophistication, Fairmont Bab Al Bahr delivers refined hospitality experiences for both business and leisure travellers.

title: Four Points by Sheraton - Al AIn
content: Four Points by Sheraton Al Ain is a contemporary hotel in the heart of Al Ain, offering comfortable accommodations, warm hospitality, and modern amenities for business and leisure travelers. The hotel features stylish rooms and suites, all-day dining at elements restaurant, meeting facilities, a fitness center, outdoor pool, and convenient access to major attractions, shopping, and business districts, ensuring a relaxing and memorable stay.

title: Grand Hyatt Abu Dhabi Hotel
content: Grand Hyatt Abu Dhabi Hotel & Residences Emirates Pearl offers a 5 star luxury hotel and premier events destination, celebrated for awe inspiring design and extraordinary architecture. Set in Abu Dhabi’s iconic West Corniche, it offers seamless access to the city’s business hub and high end shopping districts, just a 35 minute drive from Abu Dhabi International Airport.

title: Grand Mercure Majlis Residencies
content: An upscale hotel for business and leisure with comfort of a residence. Grand Mercure Majlis Residences offers a wide range of accommodation options of fully equipped Studios, One Bedroom Suites and Two Bedroom Suites. Treat yourself to Mediterranean and Arabic delicacies at our rooftop restaurant Mezzahto, French cafe La Maison du Goût. The hotel is located in the heart of Abu Dhabi city surrounded by shopping malls, commercial centers and minutes away from key attractions.

title: Gulf Circle Tours
content:
Gulf Circle Tours was established in 2001 as an independent, owner-managed company supported by a dedicated & experienced team

With offices in Abu Dhabi & Dubai, our services include:

• Team-building activities, gala dinners, and bespoke events
• Entertainment
• Tailor-made itineraries
• Visa handling

In short, we are your trusted partner and an extension of your own team in the UAE.

title: Happy Journey Travel & Tours L.L.C
content:
Happy Journey Travel & Tours LLC is an Abu Dhabi-based travel agency offering personalized travel solutions at the best possible prices for leisure and business travelers.

Our services include flight tickets, holiday packages, hotel bookings, UAE and global visas, group bookings, cruises, travel insurance, transfers, and Umrah services.

With an experienced team and trusted partners, we make every journey smooth, comfortable, and memorable.

title: Hilton Abu Dhabi Yas Island Cluster
content: Exceptional events happen here. Our sophisticated venues are ideal for exhibitions, big events, congresses, car launches, signature events, executive board meetings, and intimate occasions. Offering 2,946 sqm of flexible event space, including multiple ballrooms, multi-purpose meeting rooms, executive boardrooms, an outdoor courtyard, expansive terrace, 900 sqm of foyer space, and an events lounge on one level with a dedicated entrance and reception. Prime waterfront location on Yas Bay, 100m from Etihad Arena, near the world's largest indoor theme park.

title: Jubail Mangroves Park
content: Jubail Mangrove Park is Abu Dhabi’s first self-contained leisure and educational nature destination, offering guided tours, water activities, and immersive sustainability experiences. Home to a 2.3 km boardwalk and rich biodiversity, the park invites visitors to connect with nature through adventure, wellness, and conservation.

title: Le Royal Meridien Abu Dhabi
content: Le Royal Méridien Abu Dhabi is a landmark five-star hotel in the heart of the UAE capital, offering contemporary accommodation, diverse dining experiences, and exceptional hospitality. Ideally located near the Corniche and major cultural attractions, the hotel caters to leisure travellers seeking authentic Abu Dhabi experiences, beachfront relaxation, and seamless service.

title: Magic Arabia
content: Founded in 1985, Magic Arabia is part of Magic Travels, an independent, family-owned DMC with over 40 years of expertise and a local presence across the UAE, Oman, Egypt, Jordan, Armenia, Georgia and France. Our dedicated local teams create tailor-made experiences for FITs, groups, luxury travel and MICE. Our signature products include Magic Camps, AMAR Luxury Desert Ecolodge in the UAE and GAÏA Dahabiya on the Nile in Egypt. Magic Arabia – Local expertise. Bespoke journeys. Memorable experiences.

title: Marriott Al Forsan
content:
Unparalleled Elegance at Our Abu Dhabi Hotel, 5-Star Haven

Discover exceptional hospitality at Marriott Hotel Al Forsan, Abu Dhabi, located in Khalifa City within Al Forsan International Sports Resort and close to Zayed International Airport. Unwind in thoughtfully designed rooms and suites with modern amenities and inspiring views. Relax in our marble hammam, enjoy the outdoor pool, or explore dining experiences. For meetings, weddings and celebrations, flexible indoor and outdoor venues, bespoke catering and expert planning create seamless occasions. Whether visiting for business or leisure, experience comfort, convenience, and Marriott hospitality.

title: Masarra
content: Masarra is a full-service Destination Management Company focused on curating a unique portfolio of experiences in Abu Dhabi and the UAE. With a team of destination experts passionate about the region’s offerings, we specialise in creating tailored destination experiences, MICE offerings, and adventure activities that leave lasting impressions.

title: Mida Travels
content:
Mida Travels, one of the leading Travel and Tourism operators in Dubai since 2003,a ims at providing tailor-made packages, offering complete end to end booking solution, covering all aspects of your travel needs at an affordable price with pro-active customer service.

Concentrating on Group & Individual Travel Arrangements, we are a full-fledged agency with a dedicated team providing complete range of travel services to our corporate and leisure clients.

The Services we provide: Visa Processing, Hotel bookings, Transportation, Customized Sight-seeing Tours, Desert Safari/Dhow Cruise/Yacht cruise.

title: Millenium Al Rawdah Hotels
content: Defined by its distinctive curves and striking coral-glass façade, Millennium Al Rawdah Hotel brings a contemporary expression of Arabian hospitality to Abu Dhabi. Behind its iconic architecture lies a five-star destination where warm service, spacious rooms and suites, diverse dining, leisure experiences and elegant event spaces come together. From business stays to weekend escapes and grand celebrations, every visit is designed to leave a lasting impression.

title: Nirvana Holding
content: Nirvana Holding is an Abu Dhabi-based group established to drive the sustainable growth and international expansion of its travel and tourism businesses. Its portfolio spans travel management, global travel services, tours and logistics, supported by technology, international partnerships and a commitment to service excellence. The group continues to expand its global ecosystem while building on its strong UAE foundations.

title: Park Hyatt Abu Dhabi Hotel and Villas
content: Park Hyatt Abu Dhabi Hotel and Villas is a luxury retreat on Saadiyat Island, where understated elegance meets authentic Arabian hospitality. Designed for global travelers, affluent leaders, and leisure seekers, the resort blends serenity, cultural richness, and personalized service. From spacious beachfront villas and rejuvenating wellness experiences to award-winning dining, every detail reflects excellence. More than a destination, it offers a refined home-away-from-home experience, delivering comfort, seamless service, and unforgettable memories.

title: Passage to Arabia by Al Tayer Travel
content:
Passage to Arabia has been creating exceptional travel experiences since 1979. With over four decades of destination expertise, we are a trusted partner delivering innovative, customer-focused travel solutions across the uae and beyond.

Our services include hotel reservations, tailor-made holidays, tours and excursions, mice, airline ticketing, and chauffeured transportation. Driven by passion, reliability, and excellence, we craft seamless journeys and build lasting partnerships with clients worldwide.

title: Qasr Al Watan
content: Qasr Al Watan is a working Presidential palace in Abu Dhabi and a majestic cultural landmark that invites you to discover the rich legacy of knowledge and tradition that has shaped the UAE's journey. More than just a traditional palace, Qasr Al Watan boosts cultural understanding of the nation and emphasizes its incredible history. The palace stands as an icon of Abu Dhabi's skyline with a design exquisitely crafted to tribute to its Arabian heritage and artistry. You will feel the grandeur as you enter the grounds, and the structure and open halls echo its significance in Emirati culture.

title: Ritz Carlton Abu Dhabi, Grand Canal
content: Experience refined luxury at The Ritz-Carlton Abu Dhabi, Grand Canal where elegant rooms and private pool villas meet exceptional leisure and dining. Unwind at the lotus-inspired Ritz-Carlton Spa with seven treatment rooms, relax on the private beach or by one of Abu Dhabi's largest pools, while little ones enjoy Ritz Kids. Savor unforgettable culinary experiences across eight restaurants and bars, including MICHELIN-selected Li Jiang and Mijana, all complemented by the legendary service that defines every stay.

title: Rixos Marina Abu Dhabi
content: Rixos Marina Abu Dhabi is an iconic architectural landmark that celebrates the rich fusion of Arabic and Turkish culture, dining, and hospitality. Situated in the heart of Abu Dhabi's bustling retail, entertainment, and residential hub, the resort overlooks shimmering waters and sandy shores, embodying the city's dual identity as a cosmopolitan metropolis and an archipelago with a rich natural and aquatic heritage. With its sophisticated aquatic and Arabesque design, the resort narrates Abu Dhabi’s journey from ancient seafaring origins to a thriving modern city.

title: Rixos Premium Saadiyat
content: Escape to Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island, a luxurious all-inclusive retreat in Abu Dhabi. Nestled on pristine Saadiyat Island, the resort offers crystal-clear Arabian Sea views, exceptional service, and world-class amenities. Guests enjoy a rich culinary journey across acclaimed restaurants and unwind with refreshing drinks at elegant bars and lounges—poolside, beachside, or indoors. It's the perfect blend of relaxation, indulgence, and natural beauty.

title: Rocket Destination Tourism LLC
content: Rocket DMC International is a global Destination Management Company specializing in tailor-made travel across Turkey, Egypt, UAE, Spain, Morocco, Tunisia, Uzbekistan, Cuba, Montenegro, and Croatia. We deliver authentic, seamless experiences through expert local teams and strong partnerships. Our services include FIT & Group Travel, MICE, Concierge, and Ground Handling - combining innovation, precision, and passion to create journeys that inspire and endure.

title:
Shangri-La  & Traders Hotel 
Qaryat Al Beri
content:
Shangri-La -Nestled between a pristine 1-kilometre-long private beach and lush gardens, Shangri-La Qaryat Al Beri, Abu Dhabi is truly an oasis in the heart of the Emirates.

Traders Hotel - Anchored on a pristine private beach, Traders Hotel, Qaryat Al Beri, Abu Dhabi is an inspired destination in a vibrant metropolis.

title: Silkhaus
content: Silkhaus is a technology-driven hospitality company transforming the way people experience and manage short- and mid-term stays. With a growing portfolio of professionally operated, design-led apartments across the UAE, Silkhaus combines hotel-quality service with the comfort of home. Its technology platform streamlines booking, operations and guest experiences, while enabling property owners to maximise the potential of their assets.

title: Sofitel Abu Dhabi Corniche
content: A glittering seafront landmark, Sofitel Abu Dhabi Corniche blends French elegance with Arabian hospitality. Ideally located in the heart of Abu Dhabi, this 280-room hotel offers stunning sea views, refined service, and premium facilities. Guests can enjoy award-winning restaurants, a swimming pool, Sofitel SPA, and a fitness center. Featuring nine meeting rooms and a grand ballroom, the hotel is perfect for business and social events. Minutes from Corniche Beach and the capital’s top attractions, it offers an exceptional stay for both business and leisure.

title: Telal Resort Al Ain
content: Telal Resort Al Ain is a luxury desert retreat offering an authentic Emirati experience. Guests can choose from 10 Heritage-inspired rooms and suites and 14 Bedouin-inspired private villas—some with plunge pools and fire pits. The resort combines elegant comfort with traditional design, all set against breathtaking desert views. A range of exclusive activities await, including private safaris, falconry, camel rides, zip-lining, and cultural experiences, making it the perfect escape for luxury and adventure.

title: The Mangroves Abu Dhabi | LXR Hotels & Resorts
The St. Regis Abu Dhabi
content: Inspired by the Astor legacy of New York’s Gilded Age, The St. Regis Abu Dhabi blends timeless elegance with authentic Arabian hospitality. Set within Nation Towers along the Corniche, the hotel offers bespoke service, signature St. Regis Butler Service, refined accommodations, exceptional dining, and indulgent wellness. Guests may retreat to the private 200-meter beach overlooking the turquoise waters of the Arabian Gulf, where every moment is crafted with impeccable service and unforgettable experiences.

title:
The St. Regis Saadiyat Island Resort&
Al Wathba, Luxury Collection Resort, Abu Dhabi
content: Showcasing Abu Dhabi’s stunning coastline and desert landscapes, our luxury hospitality portfolio delivers distinctive resort experiences. On Saadiyat Island, guests enjoy a prime beachfront setting, championship golf views, proximity to the Cultural District, personalized Butler Service, and world-class wellness and dining. Complementing this, Al Wathba offers an exclusive desert escape with luxury villas, panoramic dune, authentic Arabian heritage, and immersive cultural experiences for memorable stays, retreats, and bespoke events.

title: Travco
content:
With over 25 years of experience TRAVCO has evolved as one of the leading DMC’s in the Gulf with operations in UAE, Oman & Qatar.

TRAVCO offers a wide range of in destination services with dedicated staff specializing in developing bespoke programs and itineraries to suit client’s requirements from individual travelers, leisure groups to large MICE business.

title: Venuewise
content:
Venue Wise redefines venue discovery and event booking through AI. Our smart matchmaking engine connects event organizers and corporate bookers with the most suitable venues, eliminating guesswork and saving time.

For venues and vendors, we deliver data-enriched, qualified leads through structured profiles and intelligent scoring, turning event search into measurable booking outcomes.

title: Vogo Abu Dhabi Golf Resort
content: VOGO Abu Dhabi Golf Resort & Spa is a luxury resort set around a championship golf course, offering elegant accommodation, exceptional dining, wellness experiences, and versatile event venues. Conveniently located near Abu Dhabi International Airport, the resort is an ideal destination for leisure, business, weddings, and corporate events, combining modern comfort with warm Arabian hospitality.

title: W Abu Dhabi - Yas Island
content: An exhilarating Island escape at W Abu Dhabi - Yas Island, the only hotel on top of a world-famous racetrack! Offering 499 stylish rooms and suites with direct track and marina views, the hotel invites you to unwind in comfort. Savor world-class cuisine at Garage, Brooklyn Chop House, or Pappas Taverna, and sip handcrafted beverages at W Lounge. Relax with a refreshing dip at WET Deck and Sun Deck, stay active at FIT gym, and recharge at AWAY Spa. The hotel boasts 3,520 sqm of event space, perfect for meetings and social gatherings. The hotel is pet friendly, ensuring your stay is comfortable.

title: Western Hotel
content:
Western Hotels is a subsidiary of Al Marina Holding, with three distinctive properties across Abu Dhabi's Al Dhafra region - Western Hotel Liwa, Western Hotel Ghayathi, and Western Hotel Madinat Zayed.

We offer modern comfort, world-class dining, and warm Arabian hospitality tailored for both business and leisure travellers. Rooted in the spirit of the Western Region, our hotels bring together authentic local experiences, contemporary service, and a welcoming atmosphere that reflects the rich culture and character of Abu Dhabi's Western Region.

title: Yas World Resort, Vignette Collection
content: Yas World Resort is where every stay opens the door to the very best of Yas Island. Bringing together six distinctive hotels in one connected destination, it offers families, couples and travellers effortless access to world-class theme parks, diverse dining, leisure and entertainment. More than a collection of hotels, it is a vibrant resort where every experience feels within reach and every moment invites discovery. Here, unforgettable adventures, meaningful connections and exceptional hospitality come together to create a stay beyond expectation.

title: Saadiyat Cultural District
content: Saadiyat Cultural District is where inspiration finds a home and culture comes to life in a variety of ways. Home to Zayed National Museum, Louvre Abu Dhabi, Natural History Museum Abu Dhabi, teamLab Phenomena, and more, this iconic island destination welcomes you to explore, discover, and connect with art, ideas, and experiences unlike anywhere else on earth.
